blocks.text: Sometimes, a shift in musical direction comes from the most unexpected places. For American alternative rock-band Culture Wars, that place was the Philippines. What began as another stop in their international touring journey eventually became a turning point that pushed the band to reconsider their music and embrace a sound that better reflected the energy they wanted to bring on the stage. The band shared these experiences during an intimate media interview at Nustar Resort Cebu on November 12, 2026.
